- Default agent run metadata footers to visible when `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL` is unset.
- Preserve `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL=false` as the hide/opt-out path.
- Update action metadata, docs, and envelope assertions for the new default.

## Tests

- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #385
